description:
Ship the real ToolExecutor behind the trait introduced in ball #3.

=== Scope ===

- Resolve tool name → built-in subcommand ('lernie tool <name>') or external binary ('lernie-tool-<name>' on PATH), per the ball-#1 pinned contract.
- Invoke the tool per the pinned stdio contract (argv vs stdin payload; stdout capture; exit-code semantics).
- Stream stdout to the temp path + atomic rename under steps/NNN/tool_calls/<tool-id>/, matching the ball-#1 commit shape.
- Cascade SIGTERM on stop (§2.9) with the deadline pinned by ball #1; SIGKILL if the tool does not exit cleanly.
- Surface the tool_result block for the loop (ball #3) to feed on the next step.
- Tests exercise the executor against a fixture tool subcommand implemented inline in the test binary (no shelling out to a real 'lernie tool bash' yet — that lands in #6).

=== Depends on ===

bl-e2fb — stdio contract, commit shape, SIGTERM deadline, and executor responsibilities must be pinned before coding. Independent of ball #3: #3 ships a stub executor for its own tests; #4 drops the real one in for end-to-end integration.

=== Out of scope ===

- Oversized-output auto-dispatch (deferred per epic non-goals; §3.3 update in ball #1 must reflect this descope).
- Actual tool implementations (#5, #6).
title: v0.3 tool executor (real ToolExecutor impl)
